files..claude-plugin/plugin.json:
{
  "name": "galactic-battle",
  "displayName": "Galactic Battle",
  "version": "1.1.0",
  "description": "Draws an animated space battle above the prompt while Claude works, driven by what Claude does (tool results, helpers), with a double-bladed lightsaber gauge for context and quota, blaster sounds and optional music.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Dark Velours",
    "url": "https://github.com/DarkVelours"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/DarkVelours/claude-code-galactic-battle",
  "repository": "https://github.com/DarkVelours/claude-code-galactic-battle",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "fun",
    "spinner",
    "animation",
    "space",
    "terminal",
    "mod"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Language of the battle's texts and of /battle's answers. auto follows LANG.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "fr"
      ]
    },
    "musicFile": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Music file",
      "description": "Absolute path (or ~/...) of the music played during a turn once /battle music on. Empty: ~/.claude/galactic-battle/music.mp3",
      "default": ""
    },
    "volume": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Volume",
      "description": "Volume of the blaster and the music, 0 to 100.",
      "default": 40
    },
    "details": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Info shown",
      "description": "tool: the battle shows tool names only. full: it also shows file names and commands (hide it when you record your screen).",
      "default": "tool",
      "options": [
        "tool",
        "full"
      ]
    }
  }
}
